query.originSource: GetTranslatedWorldPositionFromScreenUV(ScreenUV, SceneDepth) via LumenPosition.ush; same captured bytes as the world-cache replay

interval.separation: 20000 UU is the ray maximum; the cache's minimum interpolation distance (360.8439 UU) is the actual GDF MaxTraceDistance. The GDF min distance is the previous TraceHit distance minus 2*SurfaceBias.

iterations.coverageSource: page coverage bit clear -> shader default Coverage=1

trace.inputBasis: GDF volumes are the pass-28 native exports linked to the pass-167 bindings by DiagnosticResource; see timingCaveat.

comparison.claim: GDF miss and the bHit=false / cache-overwrite branch are reproduced. TraceHit is exact at the cache boundary. TraceRadiance is structurally explained (GDF adds zero; cache radiance * PreExposure; R11G11B10 store with dither) but not claimed bit-exact because the cache radiance is a CPU replay of GPU interpolation. Residual is <= 1 store ULP per channel.

branch.cardAddressLightingNote: not applicable: the GDF ray missed, so there is no near-field surface/card address to shade from this trace. The radiance-cache operands retained by the preceding world replay remain the lighting source.

timingCaveat.producerValidation: No graph-0001 pass outputs any of the four GDF volume IDs or their diagnostic resources. The only GDF-named graph pass that writes a GDF resource is the GlobalDistanceField.PageStatsBuffer clear. The four volumes are external/persistent native resources; their producer is outside the captured graph and is not proven by DumpGPU.
timingCaveat.statement: The four pass-167 GDF textures are external native resources. Their payloads were scheduled at pass 28 and the pass-167 binding record names the same native pointer / diagnostic resource. No graph-0001 write on those IDs is recorded. This does not prove the bytes were unchanged between pass 28 and pass 167 (no RDG execution dependency / source-state proof), so the replay reports a timing caveat and does not assert general mutable-input equivalence.

permutation.note: The pass event name is emitted only by the TraceVoxels lambda. The exact compiled permutation is not recorded by DumpGPU; CVars and non-null bindings constrain it but do not prove each bit.

unsupported: Exact compiled shader permutation (TraceVoxels, StructuredImportanceSampling, ThreadGroupSize32, RadianceCache, ScreenProbeExtraAO, HairStrands) is not recorded by DumpGPU; the replay follows the event-name/source path and captured CVars.
The four GDF volumes are pass-28 native exports reused by pass 167; no RDG execution dependency proves byte invariance between those passes.

Hardware trilinear filtering is modelled as float32 8-tap interpolation of the exported R8 volumes; GPU fixed-point filter weights are not captured. The miss margin is large (33.7 vs 9.92 UU, and page value -1 LSB still misses), so the hit/miss branch is robust even though the last fraction is not bit-exact.
The previous TraceHit read by pass 167 is the pass-163 TraceScreen output. That version is captured and used; it is a same-graph read-before-write.

The cache radiance is a CPU replay of the GPU's eight-probe interpolation; exact compiled arithmetic and any half-precision intermediates are not captured. TraceRadiance is compared only with a one-ULP store bound.
The exact indirect dispatch record (Div32 vs Div64) consumed by the device is not recorded; the selected lane is below both limits.
